這是剛放進時間表的範例方塊。點它可以改時間、開始專注；往下拉底部可以改長度；右上: This is the sample block just added. Tap it to change the time or start focusing; drag its bottom edge to change the length; ✓ marks it done and ✗ not finished. Grey stripes are your fixed schedule.
在框框打字按 Enter 就新增任務，到了那週會自動出現。任務可以拖進時間表變成: Type in the box and press Enter to add a task; it shows up in the week it starts. Drag a task onto the timetable to turn it into a block. The sample task is here.
寫下大目標和期限，拆成每週的小步驟，到那週會自動出現在任務裡。: Write a big goal and a deadline, split it into weekly steps, and each step appears in tasks in its week.
